parsedVerdict.reasoning: AttendeesService only does application-layer work. It coordinates the use case: it builds the domain entity Attendee, saves and loads it through the AttendeeRepository port injected as ATTENDEE_REPOSITORY, turns a missing record into a DomainError, and returns a plain read model. The file has no persistence code such as SQL or ORM calls, no transport handling such as HTTP status codes, request or response objects, or route decorators, and no business invariants that should live in the entity. The only NestJS framework usage is @Injectable/@Inject for dependency injection, which is normal for an application service in this project. The CreateContextDto interface is an application DTO, and DTOs belong to the application layer in this layer model. The in-memory `sequence` counter used to generate IDs is a design weakness: it is not safe across restarts or multiple instances. Assigning IDs is still an application-level concern, though, so it is not a responsibility from another layer kind.
